_about: Round 12: settled absences retagged. Cases where the lender route was tested to exhaustion get ct 'nopub' (lender publishes no terms for this kind of deal) or 'exhaust' (only a leaked, court or archive copy would carry it). 'research' is removed only where EVERY lender on the case is settled; cases with an untested second lender keep it alongside the new tag.
